n: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ (13 and 26 TOPS)
t: A Raspberry Pi 5 add-on board with a Hailo accelerator for vision AI.
steps: Find the AI HAT+ on the Raspberry Pi site and choose a version.
Gather a Raspberry Pi 5 and an optional Active Cooler.
Fit the spacers, header, and PCIe ribbon cable.
Install the AI software and models.
